title: 352 original criteria: literal inventory and concrete evidence pointers
evidence_limits: Each pointer resolves to a concrete owner review in the named immutable source snapshot; review paths and test names do not establish executed proof.
The original full expected AND prohibited clauses must both be established before an ID is accepted; a linked rule/acceptance ID does not inherit qualification.
Authentic replay parity/build success is limited to the separately recorded exact commit; native/HTTP/interactive browser fixtures were not executed before the recorded native SQL failure.
Unpublished local integrations and work in progress are not asserted to exist in this public snapshot.
The execution environment disconnected before further writes/tests; infrastructure interruption is an execution blocker, not a normative external prerequisite.
